home.metaDescription: Track spending in euros and reais, share wallets with the people you trust, and keep working offline.
home.title: Your money, in every currency you live in
home.subtitle: Track spending in euros and reais, share wallets with the people you trust, and keep working offline on your phone and computer.

currencies.title: Euros and reais
currencies.body: Each wallet has its own currency. Totals never mix them.

sharing.title: Shared wallets
sharing.body: Invite people by e-mail as admin, editor or viewer, and hand a wallet over when you need to.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: The Windows, macOS, Android and iOS apps keep working without internet and sync later.

history.title: Full history
history.body: Every change is recorded: who made it, when and from where.

security.title: Secure by default
security.body: Two-factor authentication, session control and alerts for sensitive changes.

languages.title: English and Portuguese
languages.body: Use finfy in your language, with amounts and dates in your format.

create.title: New wallet
create.body: A wallet holds accounts, cards and entries in one currency. You can share it later.
create.name: Name
create.currencyHint: You can change it until the first entry.

home.title: Home
home.emptyBody: A wallet holds accounts, cards and entries in one currency. You can share it later.
home.ready: {name} is ready. Accounts and entries come next.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.name: Name
wallet.currencyLocked: The currency is fixed after the first entry.
wallet.readOnly: Only the owner and admins can change the wallet.

archive.title: Archive wallet
archive.body: The wallet leaves the list of every member. Its data and history are kept.

accounts.emptyBody: Add your checking account, savings, or the cash in your wallet.
accounts.readOnly: As a viewer, you can see the accounts but not change them.
accounts.loadError: The accounts could not be loaded.

form.name: Name
form.initialBalanceHint: What the account had before your first entry in finfy. It can be negative.
form.isDefaultHint: Comes selected when you add an entry.

archive.title: Archive {name}?
archive.body: The account leaves the list. Its entries are kept, and you can restore it later.

categories.title: Categories
categories.settingsBody: Hide the standard categories you don't use, or create your own.
categories.readOnly: As a viewer, you can see the categories but not change them.
categories.loadError: The categories could not be loaded.

archive.title: Archive {name}?
archive.body: Its subcategories are archived too. Entries keep their category.

entries.emptyHint: Add an expense, an income or a transfer.
entries.noAccounts: Create an account first, in Accounts and cards.
entries.readOnly: As a viewer, you can see the entries but not change them.
entries.loadError: The entries could not be loaded.

form.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount greater than zero, like {example}.
form.paidHint: Turn off for something still to pay or receive.

delete.title: Delete this entry?
delete.transferBody: Both sides of the transfer are deleted. The history keeps a record.
delete.body: The history keeps a record of it.

cards.title: Credit cards
cards.emptyHint: Add a card to track purchases and invoices.
cards.needsAccount: Create an account first: a card needs one to pay its invoices.

form.name: Name
form.daysHint: Purchases after the closing day go to the next invoice.

archive.title: Archive {name}?
archive.body: The card leaves the list. Its invoices and purchases are kept.

detail.notFound: This card does not exist or was archived.
detail.reopenBody: The payment is deleted and the money goes back to the account.

purchase.editHint: Changes apply to every installment. To change the amount or date, delete it and add it again.
